Class GraphPane

java.lang.Object
java.awt.Component
java.awt.Container
javax.swing.JComponent
javax.swing.JPanel
org.aetheris.lcarsgraph.GraphPane
All Implemented Interfaces:
ImageObserver, MenuContainer, Serializable, Accessible
public final class GraphPane extends JPanel
The graph is its own pane. It opens on the force picture. The bar ground keeps its hue. Saturation and brightness are four fifths of the source.

    • rendering

      public void rendering(boolean on)
      The method shows the rendering spinner while a walk is in flight. A call off the event thread posts itself and returns.
      Parameters:
      on - True shows the spinner. False hides it.

    • renderingCluster

      public JComponent renderingCluster()
      The method returns the rendering spinner. The host shows this spinner only while the graph tab is in front. Another graph keeps its own spinner. The host seats it to the right of the menu bar while the control bar is folded. The host seats it on the lower button bar while the control bar is open. The graph button bar does not hold it.
      Returns:
      The return value is that spinner.

    • foot

      public void foot(JComponent band)
      The method seats one band on the south of the graph pane. The same band returns without a swap. A null band clears the south. A call off the event thread posts itself and returns.
      Parameters:
      band - The band is the thinking pane, or null.

      void holdSeats(String layout, List<String[]> rows)
      The method keeps the seats the vault thread already read. The picture thread applies this copy. A null layout is ignored.

      layout - The layout name is layered, force, or radial.
      rows - Each row is the painted id, the x, and the y.

    • heldSeats

      List<String[]> heldSeats(String layout)
      The method returns the seats already held for one layout. The picture thread reads this copy. A missing layout returns an empty list.

    • landPicture

      void landPicture(GraphModel frozen)
      The method places one frozen generation. The picture thread calls this method. The live model stays unread. Seats already held stay. A missing id takes a fresh place.
      Parameters:
      frozen - The snapshot the model thread handed over.

    • focusIntent

      void focusIntent(String id)
      The method opens the closer picture on one intent. The picture keeps that intent, its meat words, and a door intent. A door intent draws alone, on a ring around the focused intent. A drag in this picture stays on the close canvas. The seats of the open layout stay.
      Parameters:
      id - The id is the intent under the double-click.

    • releaseFocus

      void releaseFocus()
      The method leaves the closer picture. The zoomed-out page of the layout that was open before the double-click returns.
